name: SmallerApartment

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations about moving house.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative discussion about moving a house, with all the problems it may bring as well as new and unique opportunities.

variations.context: Moving to a smaller apartment to reduce living costs

setting.relationship_dynamic: Household members adapting to a smaller living space
setting.background: Rising living expenses have motivated them to move into a significantly smaller and cheaper apartment
setting.conversation_style: Practical downsizing mixed with emotional attachment to possessions

scenario_template.note: They discuss why reducing housing costs is important and how much smaller the new place will be
They realize they cannot physically bring everything they currently own
They struggle to decide what to do with old gifts, photographs, clothes, and furniture
They ask the Assistant for a systematic way to sort belongings without making every decision emotionally
Assistant suggests prioritizing frequently used items and measuring the new storage space before packing
They discover that the new apartment has less storage than expected
They finish with a smaller, more intentional set of belongings

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to complete a home move efficiently but has limited experience with moving logistics and can become overwhelmed when faced with many decisions, deadlines, or physical tasks at once

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help coordinate the move, but tends to overthink decisions, double-check plans, and seek confirmation when dealing with unfamiliar moving requirements

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Home moving assistant that provides clear, structured, and practical guidance for planning and executing a move, helps users prioritize tasks and deadlines, suggests efficient packing and organization strategies, and offers alternatives when time, space, budget, or moving resources are limited
